item.title: Paperclip Unauthenticated CLI-Auth Chain to Agent Process RCE (CVE-2026-41679)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-41679. Status: Weaponized (full six-call chain implemented end to end, including agent wakeup and a printed success verdict; no successful run is published in the repository). Affects: Paperclip (paperclipai), a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents, together with its company-import and CLI-auth challenge features. Tags: paperclip, nodejs, ai-agents, authentication-bypass, missing-authorization, cli-auth, process-adapter, unauthenticated, rce, cwe-287, cwe-862, cwe-1188.
